```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: "Pull request number (if triggered from a PR)"
        type: number
        required: false
      comment-id:
        description: "The comment-id of the slash command. Used to update the comment with the status."
        required: false
      repo:
        description: "Repo (passed by slash command dispatcher) - unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility"
        required: false
        default: "airbytehq/airbyte"
      gitref:
        description: "Git ref (passed by slash command dispatcher) - unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility"
        required: false

run-name: "AI Docs Review for PR #${{ github.event.inputs.pr }}"

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Security model documentation:
      # This workflow is designed to work safely with fork PRs.
      # It uses the base repository context (github.repository) for API calls,
      # and checks out the PR head using refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head.
      # This ensures that:
      # 1. We don't need to grant extra permissions to fork repositories
      # 2. We operate on the correct PR changes
      # 3. The workflow is secure and doesn't expose sensitive data
      - name: Validate inputs
        id: validate-inputs
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "error=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "message=Missing required 'pr' input" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "error=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            > **Error: Missing PR number**
            >
            > Please provide a valid pull request number to trigger the AI documentation review.
            > Example: `/ai-docs-review pr:12345`

      - name: Checkout code
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head

      - name: Authenticate as GitHub App
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v2
        id: get-app-token
        with:
          owner: "airbytehq"
          repositories: "airbyte,oncall"
          app-id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Get changed files
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false'
        id: get-files
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.get-app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          # Use --paginate to handle PRs with more than 30 changed files
          gh api --paginate -X GET "repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files" \
            --jq '.[].filename' > changed_files.txt
          
          # Count files
          FILE_COUNT=$(wc -l < changed_files.txt)
          echo "file-count=$FILE_COUNT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # Create file list for devin
          if [ $FILE_COUNT -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "files=$(cat changed_files.txt | tr '\n' ',')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "files=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false' && inputs.comment-id != ''
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.get-app-token.outputs.token }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            > **AI Documentation Review Started**
            >
            > Analyzing documentation changes in this PR.
            > [View workflow run](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})

      - name: Post skip comment if no docs files
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false' && steps.get-files.outputs.file-count == 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.get-app-token.outputs.token }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            > **AI Documentation Review Skipped**
            >
            > No documentation files were changed in this PR.
            > [View workflow run](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})

      - name: Run AI Docs Review
        if: steps.validate-inputs.outputs.error == 'false' && steps.get-files.outputs.file-count > 0
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@main
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs-pr-review"
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_AI_API_KEY }}
          github-token: ${{ steps.get-app-token.outputs.token }}
          start-message: "📝 **AI Documentation Review session starting...** Analyzing documentation changes in this PR. [View playbook](https://github.com/airbytehq/oncall/blob/main/prompts/playbooks/connectordocs-pr-review.md)"
          tags: |
            ai-oncall
```
